Course Overview

The Product Design (UI & UX) course teaches students how to create user-centered digital experiences that are both beautiful and functional.

You’ll learn how to design intuitive interfaces, conduct user research, and apply UX principles to solve real-world problems through design.

This beginner-to-intermediate course blends creativity and strategy equipping you with the tools and mindset to design digital products that users love, from mobile apps to web platforms.

Learning Outcome

  1. Understand and apply key UI/UX design principles, including usability, accessibility, and interaction design.
  2. Conduct user research, create personas, and map user journeys to guide design decisions.
  3. Use industry-standard tools like Figma, Adobe XD, and FigJam to create wireframes, prototypes, and visual interfaces.
  4. Design and present end-to-end digital product solutions backed by research and design systems.

Career Opportunities

  1. United States – $85,000 – $130,000 USD
  2. United Kingdom – £50,000 – £90,000 GBP
  3. Canada – $70,000 – $110,000 CAD
  4. Germany – €55,000 – €95,000 EUR
  5. Nigeria – ₦5.5 million – ₦10 million NGN
  6. Kenya – KSh 2.8 million – KSh 4.8 million KES
  7. Remote/Global Roles – $75,000 – $120,000 USD

Career Pathways

  1. UI/UX Designer
  2. Product Designer
  3. UX Researcher

  5. Design Systems Specialist

What You Will Learn

Go from Idea to Impact, become a Product Designer in 3-6 Months.

Module 1 - Introduction to Product Design
  • Overview of product design & Industry Expectation
  • Understanding the role of product designer
  • Design Thinking & Human-Centered Design
  • Overview of tools (Figma, Miro, Notion, etc.)
  • Exercise
Module 2 - UX Fundamentals & Design Thinking
  • Introduction to UX principles
  • Design thinking process (Empathize, Define, Ideate, Prototype, Test)
  • Conducting user research & interviews
  • Assignment
Module 3 - Information Architecture & User Flows
  • What is Information Architecture (IA)?
  • Tools & Techniques
  • Understanding User Flows & Task Flows
  • Understanding Sitemaps
  • Class Exercise
Module 4 - Wireframing & Low-Fidelity Prototyping
  • Wireframe principles
  • Layout & hierarchy
  • Sketching interfaces
  • Building low-fidelity prototypes in Figma
  • Assignment
Module 5 - UI Basics – Layout, Typography, & Colors
  • Understanding UI design principles
  • Usability heuristics
  • Typography & Color
  • Understanding visual hierarchy and accessibility (WCAG)
  • Introduction to Design system.
  • Capstone Project Brief
Module 6 - High-Fidelity Design & Components
  • Creating reusable Figma components
  • Auto Layout & constraints
  • Grids & responsive layouts
  • Visual consistency & branding
  • Assigments
Module 7 - Prototyping & Microinteractions
  • Figma prototyping basics
  • Smart animate & transitions
  • Microinteractions
  • Assignments
Module 8 - Usability Testing & Iteration
  • Setting usability test goals
  • Test planning & recruitment
  • Moderated vs unmoderated testing
  • Analyzing feedback and iterating designs
Module 9: Product Thinking & Strategy
  • The role of design in business success
  • Design decisions based on business goals
  • Metrics for measuring design impact
  • Assignments
Module 10: Design Handoff & Collaboration
  • Handoff best practices in Figma
  • Design documentation
  • Working with developers & product managers
  • Version control and commenting
Module 11: Portfolio Building & Case Studies
  • How to write compelling case studies
  • Storytelling for product designers
  • Structuring a UX portfolio
  • Presenting your design work
  • Assignment
Module 12 : Final Project Presentation & Review
  • Final project presentations
  • Peer review & feedback
  • Discussion: Next steps in your design career
